title: OpenList Management

media_lib.base_desc: Master switch, Emby / OpenSubsonic endpoints and app keys
media_lib.protocol_disabled: Not enabled (turn on {{key}} in the settings above)
media_lib.protocol_auth_tip: If the Emby/Subsonic client has no key field, use your OpenList username and put the app key in the password field. For Subsonic clients that append /rest automatically, set the address to /@rest.
media_lib.app_keys_desc: Used for Subsonic token auth, Emby api_key and headless clients such as MoviePilot. If a client has no key field, enter your OpenList username and put the key in the password field
media_lib.key_once: This key is shown only once, copy it now:
media_lib.scrape_desc: Metadata sources, thumbnail storage and scrape concurrency
media_lib.strm_desc: Generate .strm files during scan, or run a bulk generation here
media_lib.strm_output_same_dir: Next to the media files (same name, .strm extension)
media_lib.strm_output_missing: Not configured (save the STRM directory above first)
media_lib.thumb_scope: Applies to {{type}} only; falls back to the global media settings when unset.
media_lib.thumb_store_tips: Generate thumbnails while scraping; when off, the original image path is used as the cover
media_lib.mode_base64_tips: Thumbnails are stored in the database as Base64. No extra file storage is needed, but the database grows.
media_lib.mode_runtime_tips: Thumbnails are stored under the program data directory, data/imgs by default. No mounted storage is required.
media_lib.mode_local_tips: Thumbnails are written to a VFS path under a mounted storage, which must be writable (e.g. /imgs).
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_runtime: Path relative to the program data directory, imgs by default (data/imgs)
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_local: VFS path relative to the mount root /, e.g. /imgs or /.thumbnail
media_lib.thumb_rerun: Changes take effect after re-scraping (clear scraped data in Media Manage, then run scraping again).
media_lib.thumb_config_missing: Media type config not loaded, please refresh and try again
media_lib.thumb_saved: Thumbnail settings saved, effective after re-scraping

not_admin: You are not an admin user, please login with an admin account.
plugins_intro: Enable or disable installed plugins. Disabled plugins stay installed but contribute nothing to the UI.
plugins_backend_intro: Write your own server-side plugins in Go. They run in-process via the yaegi interpreter, subscribe to lifecycle hooks, and hot-reload on save. Plugins may use the Go standard library; backend internals are out of reach.
plugins_backend_empty: No backend plugins yet. Create one to get started.
plugin_delete_confirm: Delete plugin "{{name}}"? This removes its source file.

cluster.title: Cluster credential sharing
cluster.intro: Share ONLY credentials (tokens/cookies/secrets) between manually-paired storages on different nodes, in real time. Nodes authenticate with a shared key; all traffic is end-to-end encrypted. Peers auto-discover each other. Disabled by default.
cluster.key_hint: Every node in the cluster must use the exact same key. It both authenticates membership and encrypts all traffic. Leave blank to keep the current key.
cluster.key_placeholder: leave blank to keep current key
cluster.label: This node's name
cluster.label_hint: A friendly name shown for this node on every node's cluster panel.
cluster.addr_hint: Optional. Advertising a reachable base URL lets other nodes auto-discover and dial this node. Leave empty for nodes behind NAT.
cluster.seeds_hint: Optional. One base URL per line to dial when first joining a cluster; the rest of the mesh is then discovered automatically.
cluster.apply_remote_hint: When on, this node updates its own storages with credentials shared by group peers. Off = share-only.
cluster.groups_hint: Each group links storages across nodes that should share one credential (e.g. the same account mounted on several nodes). Only the credential is synced — every other setting stays local to each node.
cluster.no_groups: No sync groups yet. Create one and add the storages that share an account.
cluster.mixed_warning: Some members predate refresher leases and still refresh on their own. Upgrade them to stop credentials being revoked.
cluster.legacy_hint: Predates refresher leases; refreshes on its own
cluster.links_hint: One link per node pair. Queue counts coalesced items waiting to be sent.
